items.lede: FCC Chairman Brendan Carr announced the agency will vote on November 19th on rules that would allow prisons to use signal jamming. Radiofrequency jammers are generally banned under Section 333 and the Communications Act of 1934, with few exceptions, and Carr has noted they've been permitted for use at some federal facilities already. items.title: Brendan Carr plans to let prisons jam cellphone signals

items.lede: The agency will vote next month on relaxing its long-standing opposition to jammers.
items.title: FCC chair wants to let prisons jam illegal cellphones
